# Abhyashify

> Pick your exam and get a day-by-day timetable up to exam day, with alarms, study-time tracking, weekly reports and an assistant in English and Hindi.

Abhyashify is a free, open-source study planner for competitive exams (JEE, NEET, GATE, UPSC, SSC, NDA, CDS, CAT / MBA, CLAT / Law, CA, Banking, Railways (RRB), CUET UG, NET / JAM, Teaching (CTET / TET), School boards, State PSC). It runs in the browser, installs like an app, and works in English and Hindi. Subjects and typical timings were written from general knowledge, not taken from official sites, so users must confirm exam dates and syllabus with the exam body.

## Main pages

- [Abhyashify app](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/): the planner itself (needs JavaScript)
- [About, how it works and FAQ](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/about/): what it does, the setup steps and answers to common questions
- [Study planners by exam](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/): every exam family and paper with its preloaded subjects
- [हिन्दी में जानकारी](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/hi/about/): the same information in Hindi
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/aditya454760/Abhyashify)

## Exam pages

- [JEE](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/jee/): Engineering and architecture entrance
- [NEET](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/neet/): Medical entrance (UG and PG)
- [GATE](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/gate/): Postgraduate engineering and science entrance (M.Tech, IISc, PSUs)
- [UPSC](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/upsc/): Civil Services and engineering services
- [SSC](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/ssc/): Staff Selection Commission exams
- [NDA](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/nda/): National Defence Academy and Naval Academy
- [CDS](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/cds/): Combined Defence Services (officer entry)
- [CAT / MBA](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/cat/): Management entrance exams
- [CLAT / Law](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/clat/): Law entrance exams
- [CA](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/ca/): Chartered Accountancy (ICAI)
- [Banking](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/bank/): IBPS, SBI and other bank exams
- [Railways (RRB)](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/rail/): RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP
- [CUET UG](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/cuet/): Central university entrance
- [NET / JAM](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/net/): UGC NET, CSIR NET, IIT JAM
- [Teaching (CTET / TET)](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/tet/): Teacher eligibility tests
- [School boards](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/board/): Class 10 and class 12
- [State PSC](https://aditya454760.github.io/Abhyashify/exams/psc/): State civil services
